title: Fix 11 pre-existing link test failures (TOFU capacity + security persistence)
description: On the current dirty tree (uncommitted python/src wave), these fail: tests/link/test_link_rx.py::TestLinkLayerRoundTrip::test_tofu_capacity_with_all_pins_leased_rejects_atomically (3 params); tests/link/test_link_security_persistence.py: test_restored_transmit_counter_cannot_be_reset (DID NOT RAISE RuntimeError), test_persistence_fault_terminally_disables_link_and_drops_queue (4 params), test_receive_anchor_failure_returns_no_receipt_and_disables_sessions, test_corrupt_restarted_t0_tombstone_fails_closed, test_persistence_failure_revokes_cached_policy_capabilities. Likely root cause in the same uncommitted wave that moved PEER_DB_MAX_SIZE. Discovered during project-LICHEN-2auf.35.2 verification (frame-focused suites pass: 135 passed).
notes: Completed the stale LinkPersistence extraction boundary without reverting accumulated work. Production fix: restored durable TX counters now set LinkLayer._sequence_started, so set_sequence cannot reset a counter potentially observed by peers. Removed obsolete duplicate persistence revision/failure/anchor/transition fields from LinkLayer; LinkPersistence remains the sole journal-state owner, and its unused duplicate sequence-started state was removed. Updated fault-injection/corruption tests to patch/read the extracted LinkPersistence owner and simulate terminal failure through the real handler. Updated TOFU saturation assertions to the dedicated fail-closed ReceiveError.CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED while retaining atomic trust/replay invariants. Validation: original failure selection 32 passed; complete python tests/link suite 806 passed, 10 skipped (one unrelated pytest deprecation warning); python tests/test_node.py 125 passed; Ruff on all four touched paths passed; git diff --check passed. No live collision observed.
